title: Gold Import Duty Raised from 6% to 15%: Full Impact Explained
content:
On 10th May 2026, Prime Minister Narendra Modi spoke directly to the people of India. In a simple and emotional appeal, he requested everyone to stop buying gold for weddings and functions for one year.

As we all know, the value of the dollar is increasing day by day. With global tensions rising and pressure on our foreign reserves, Prime Minister Modi appealed to citizens to put the nation’s needs before tradition and stop buying gold for one year. 

In a country that loves gold so much, this request has left everyone thinking. Will Indians listen? Let’s know each and everything regarding if we purchase gold or not.

What is Gold Import Duty?

Gold Import Duty is basically a tax that the Indian government collects when gold is imported from other countries. For example if you bring the gold from other countries you need to pay Import Duty in form of tex.Right now, it stands at 15%. The main aim is to control how much gold India buys from abroad, protect our foreign reserves, and discourage people from spending too much on gold.

Reasons Behind PM Modi’s Decision to Increase Gold Import Duty

Everyone is excited to know why PM increased the import duty on gold as it is loved by every Indian citizens. The main reasons are rising global tensions, a stronger dollar, and increasing pressure on India’s foreign reserves. By raising the duty to 15%, the government wants to reduce heavy gold imports, save precious foreign currency, and encourage people to think twice before buying more gold.

Impact of Increased Gold Import Duty on Common Indians in 2026

The increased gold import duty to 15% has started showing its impact in 2026. Common people are now paying higher prices for gold jewellery, making weddings and festivals more expensive. Gold shopkeepers are seeing fewer customers and slower sales. On the international front, reduced demand from India is putting slight pressure on global gold prices. Overall, the move is helping the government control imports but is pinching the pockets of ordinary Indians.

Final Thoughts: The Real Cost of Gold in Today’s India 

Gold is more than just jewellery, it's an emotion for every Indian. But in 2026, loving gold has become expensive for both families and the country. With higher import duty and the PM's appeal, it’s time to pause and think. Every extra gram costs more now. Saving dollars today can make India stronger tomorrow. Let’s celebrate wisely.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Q: Why was the gold import duty raised to 15%?
Indian Government increased the import duty on gold because the dollar value is increasing rapidly and to reduce the trade deficit, and stabilize the national currency, the government has taken this step.
Q: How does this impact jewelry prices?
The increase in gold import duty leads to the increase in retail gold prices, making jewelry more expensive for domestic consumers.
Q: Will this affect the jewelry industry?
Offcourse, the increase in the gold import duty affects the jewelry industry as it reduces the customers and the demand also gets reduced.
Q: What is the Gold Price Today?
The gold price is not the same everyday. Individuals can check the current gold price from its official websites.

title: New Skoda Elroq Promises 570+ km Driving Range and Premium Cabin Tech
content:
Hello, friends here is the latest update for all the car lovers and buyers who are planning to own a new electric car. Skoda announced the launch of an all new Elroq claiming 570+ km, premium cabin, 175 kW fast charging and multiple features with the starting price of ₹45 lakh in Indian Market.

In this new Skoda Elroq you will see outstanding design, luxurious interior, powerful motor and advanced features making it a futuristic car. Lets explore the new upcoming Skoda Elroq 2026 through this page.

Skoda Elroq EV 2026 Price & Launch Date

Before starting, the most important things to know are the expected price and launch timeline of the Skoda Elroq. Skoda is likely to launch this premium EV in India by mid-2026. Looking at its features and positioning, the expected price range could be between ₹35 lakh and ₹45 lakh (ex-showroom).

Skoda Elroq 2026 EV

Buyers and enthusiasts waiting for the new Skoda Elroq EV are updated that Skoda has given final touch to the Elroq and is planning to introduce it by next month June 2026. In this upcoming EV Skoda offers interesting features like fast charging, ADAS, a 13-inch touchscreen, and connected car features. The EV could come with 59 kWh and 77 kWh battery options, and up to 573 km range, ideal for both long and city drives.

New Skoda Elroq 2026 Range & Performance

Skoda Elroq 2026 model comes with a powerful 63 kWh and 82 kWh battery packs which delivers around 204 PS and 286 PS and 573 km WLTP range. If we talk about its charging support then in 10 – 80% charging in just 24 – 28 minutes. When it comes to its performance then it reaches 0 to 100 km/h in 6.6 seconds. Buyers who want a stylish, powerful and compact EV then Skoda Elroq 2026 is the best option for you.

2026 Elroq EV Interior and Exterior Features

Skoda Elroq 2026 model is a feature-rich compact EV with a premium and modern cabin. Its interior gets a 13-inch touchscreen, digital driver display, wireless charging, connected car tech, premium audio system, and multiple comfort features. On the outside, the SUV comes with a stylish design, sharp LED lighting, sporty alloy wheels, and aerodynamic styling that gives it a futuristic road presence.

Who Should Buy a New Elroq EV?

Basically, Skoda Elroq 2026 is designed for those buyers who want a stylish look, premium cabin, long driving range, and a compact SUV with modern EV technology. With its luxury features, fast charging support, and practical design, it can become a strong option in the premium electric SUV segment.

Skoda Elroq Maintenance and Running Cost

The Skoda Elroq is expected to have lower maintenance costs compared to petrol and diesel SUVs. Since EVs have fewer moving parts, owners may spend less on regular servicing and engine-related repairs. Fast charging support and modern battery technology can also make daily usage more convenient and efficient.

If you are planning to purchase a new seven seater SUV then this post is for you. Explore the all new 2026 Škoda Kodiaq through this article.

As the new Škoda Kodiaq 2026 arrives with premium features, a refreshed design, and advanced technology, buyers are also eager to know its variant-wise pricing. Škoda Kodiaq 2026 Engine & Performance

When it comes to the performance Skoda is always one step ahead. If we talk about the Škoda Kodiaq engine and performance then the SUV is powered by a 2.0-litre turbo-petrol engine that produces 190 PS of power and 320 Nm of torque. It comes with a smooth 7-speed DSG automatic gearbox which produces a smooth driving experience on both city roads and highways.

Škoda Kodiaq 2026 Features

Skoda offers multiple advance features which makes the Škoda Kodiaq a premium and futuristic SUV. Here are the few Skoda Kodiaq features listed below:-

  • Large 13-inch floating touchscreen infotainment system.

  • Fully digital driver cockpit display.

  • Wireless Android Auto & Apple CarPlay support.

  • Panoramic sunroof for an airy cabin experience.

  • Ventilated and powered front seats.

  • Premium ambient interior lighting.

Multi-zone automatic climate control.

  • 360-degree surround camera.

  • Level-2 ADAS safety technology.

  • Adaptive cruise control with lane assist.

  • Wireless smartphone charging with cooling function.

  • Premium sound system for enhanced audio quality.

  • Connected car features with smart controls.

  • Multiple driving modes with AWD capability.

  • Spacious 5 and 7-seater cabin options.

Skoda Kodiaq 2026 Model Interior & Exterior

Skoda Kodiaq offers an attractive design and a bold road presence with its sharp LED lighting, front grille, sporty alloy wheels, and muscular body styling. Its outstanding exterior gives an attractive look and makes it a more sophisticated and dynamic look.

If we talk about its interior then Kodiaq welcomes with a premium interior including big size digital infotainment system, panoramic sunroof, multi-zone automatic climate control, comfortable seats, large boot space, etc.

New Skoda Kodiaq 2026 Safety Features

 When it comes to safety, the Škoda Kodiaq continues to set high standards in the premium SUV segment. The latest model is loaded with modern protection features like Level-2 ADAS, adaptive cruise control, lane keeping assist, blind spot detection, multiple airbags, and a 360-degree camera system. 

Whether driving in city traffic or cruising on highways, these intelligent safety technologies help make every journey safer, smoother, and more confidence-inspiring for both the driver and passengers.

Who Should Buy Skoda Kodiaq 2026?

Buyers planning to purchase a seven seater family car with luxurious interior and next level features then the Škoda Kodiaq latest model is the best option. Its premium European styling, powerful performance, advanced safety technology, and spacious cabin, the new Kodiaq delivers a perfect balance of comfort, practicality, and modern driving experience for families.

Q: Is Skoda Kodiaq 2026 Launched?
Yes, Skoda has officially launched the 2026 model of Kodiaq and the sales are open now.

Its luxurious interior, power engine, advanced features and outstanding exterior makes it a special SUV from others.

The ex-showroom price of Skoda Kodiaq 2026 starts at ₹36.99 Lakh and varies as per the variants.

Skoda Kodiaq 2026 is available in both Petrol and Diesel fuel options.
